LOG_FILE.description: Path to log file. None means stdout/standard logging.

DOWNLOAD_RETRIES.description: Number of retries for downloading images.

CMD_LINE_ARGS.description: Extra cmdline args for the qemu invocation (list format).

CMD_LINE_ENVS.description: Extra environment variables for the qemu invocation (dict format rendered as string? No, literal dict repr).

CMD_LINE_ARGS_COREOS.description: Extra coreos cmdline args for the qemu invocation.

CMD_LINE_ENVS_COREOS.description: Extra coreos environment variables for the qemu invocation.

BOOT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for an instance to boot.

IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds to kill unfinished downloads.

BACKINGSTORE_SIZE.description: Maximum space (in GiB) that unused images can occupy.

CACHE_IMAGES.description: Is reusing the local image url cache an option?

TRUST_DEADLINE.description: How old (in days) a local image url cache can be to take it as viable.

RAM_COREOS.description: RAM size for CoreOS, in MiB.

DISK_SIZE.description: Desired size, in GiB of instance disks. 0 leaves disk capacity identical to source image.

DISK_SIZE_COREOS.description: Desired size, in GiB of CoreOS instance disks.

STOP_RETRIES.description: Number of retries when stopping of instance fails.

STOP_RETRY_WAIT.description: Waiting time between stop retries, in seconds.

UEFI.description: Desired VM type: False = BIOS, True = UEFI.

SSH_USER_PORT_BASE.description: Port base for userspace sessions for SSH forward.

VAGRANT_USER_SESSION_WAIT.description: How long testcloud will wait before typing into the vms's console.

VARGANT_CENTOS_SH.description: Shell script for Vagrant CentOS setup.

VAGRANT_FEDORA_SH.description: Shell script for Vagrant Fedora setup.
